name: Protocol Lock
effect: Hard-lock one meal into your database, bypassing all conflicts
description: Execute admin privileges to permanently lock one meal into your sustenance array. Encrypted. Immutable. Final.

name: Seal of Destiny
effect: Lock one meal into your fate, securing it for the final quest
description: Channel ancient magic to seal your chosen meal. Once locked, not even the dragons of discord can remove it from your legendary menu.

name: Blood Pact
effect: Seal one meal with a blood pact - bound by dark forces
description: The mansion demands a sacrifice. Bind one meal with ancient magic. Once sealed in blood, not even death can break this cursed agreement.

name: Royal Decree
effect: Issue a royal decree to lock one meal into the banquet
description: By royal proclamation, one meal shall be decreed into the feast. Let it be known throughout the kingdom - this dish is law.

name: Case Closed
effect: Close the case on one meal - no further investigation needed
description: Sometimes a detective knows when the evidence is solid. Lock one meal into the case file. Closed. Solved. No disputes.

name: Captain's Orders
effect: By captain's decree, lock one meal into the ship's provisions
description: Ye be the captain of this vessel! Decree one meal as locked cargo. What the captain commands, the crew obeys. No mutiny can change it.

name: Mission Critical
effect: Mark one meal as mission-critical, locking it into rations
description: Mission Control authorizes priority lock. Designate one meal as mission-critical. Once locked, it's non-negotiable for mission success.

name: Claim Stake
effect: Stake your claim on one meal, partner - no disputes allowed
description: Plant your flag on one meal and stake your claim. Out here in the west, a claim stake is law. Nobody can take what's rightfully yours.

name: System Reboot
effect: Refresh the menu database while keeping synced entries
description: Initiate a core dump and refresh the meal subroutines. Synchronized data points remain intact in the cloud.

name: Scroll of Fortune
effect: Conjure new meal options while preserving your progress
description: Invoke ancient arcane arts to reveal new culinary possibilities. Your harmonies and partial harmonies remain protected by magical wards.

name: Séance
effect: Summon new spirits while bound souls remain trapped
description: Light the candles and commune with the other side for new visions. Spirits already bound to this realm cannot escape.

name: Royal Decree
effect: Command new dishes while preserving court agreements
description: Issue a royal proclamation for new culinary offerings. Treaties already signed with the other court remain binding.

name: New Lead
effect: Dig up fresh options while keeping your evidence
description: Tap your sources and uncover new leads in this culinary mystery. Your solid evidence stays locked in the case file.

name: Chart New Waters
effect: Discover new treasures while guarding your plunder
description: Set sail for uncharted waters and find new booty. Yer buried treasure and marked spots stay safe on the map.

name: Scan New Sector
effect: Discover new provisions while maintaining docked cargo
description: Activate long-range scanners to detect new nutritional resources. Already synchronized cargo manifests remain in the ship's computer.

name: New Frontier
effect: Scout for new grub while keeping your claimed territory
description: Ride out to explore new horizons and discover fresh vittles. Your staked claims and handshake deals stay honored.

name: Food Courier
effect: Order delivery via neural link - instant harmony
description: Drone delivery inbound. Hot food arrives in 5 minutes. Skip cooking and jack in to flavor.

name: Tavern Delivery
effect: Summon food from the local tavern - instant harmony
description: A mystical courier arrives bearing hot food from the village tavern. Skip the quest and feast immediately.

name: Mysterious Delivery
effect: Accept the stranger's gift - instant harmony
description: A pale figure leaves a warm meal at your door. Don't ask where it came from.

name: Royal Courier
effect: Summon the royal kitchens - instant harmony
description: The royal kitchens send a feast to your door. Let the servants handle dinner tonight.

name: Diner Delivery
effect: Call the corner diner - instant harmony
description: The diner on 5th sends over their special. Sometimes the case can wait.

name: Port Provisions
effect: Order from the port tavern - instant harmony
description: Fresh catch from the port tavern delivered to yer ship. No need to cook tonight matey.

name: Ration Override
effect: Access emergency rations - instant harmony
description: Mission Control approves emergency ration deployment. Nutritionally complete meal incoming.

name: Saloon Grub
effect: Order from the saloon - instant harmony
description: The saloon's cook sends over a hot meal. No need to rustle up grub tonight.

name: Neon Nights
effect: Enter a dystopian future of digital menus and chrome dreams
description: Welcome to the Grid. Your meal selection becomes a hack through corporate food databases. Neon signs flicker as you navigate the digital sprawl of dinner options.

name: Epic Quest
effect: Transform your journey into an epic fantasy quest
description: The realm calls to you. Your culinary quest becomes an epic journey through mystical lands, where meals are legendary treasures and harmony brings forth ancient power.

name: Midnight Manor
effect: A haunted mansion where dinner choices lurk in shadows
description: The old mansion creaks. Something stirs in the kitchen. Your meal selections emerge from the darkness, and only through harmony can you escape before midnight strikes thirteen.

name: Royal Banquet
effect: Prepare a feast fit for kings and queens
description: Hear ye, hear ye! The royal court assembles for the grandest banquet in all the kingdom. Your selections shall grace the table of nobility. Let the feast begin!

name: Case Files
effect: A mystery unfolds in shadowy black and white
description: It was a dark and stormy night. The case of the missing dinner grows cold. You'll need to crack this mystery wide open, detective. Every meal is a clue, every harmony brings you closer to the truth.

name: High Seas
effect: Set sail for adventure on the open ocean
description: Ahoy, matey! Ye be settin' sail on a grand voyage fer treasure. Each meal be a chest of gold, and harmonies make ye the richest scallywag on the seven seas.

name: Cosmic Voyage
effect: Journey through the stars on an interstellar mission
description: Mission Control, do you read? Your deep space expedition requires careful meal planning across the galaxy. Navigate asteroid fields of choices and establish harmonies across the cosmos.

name: Frontier Feast
effect: Head out west to the dusty frontier saloon
description: Partner, this here's the Wild West. Your dinner decisions become high-noon showdowns at the saloon. Harmonies are struck like gold, conflicts settled with a duel at sunset.
